messages:
anya: Quick doc bug spotted in /v1/ingest docs: request examples still show "prefill" and error examples use "error_message". Live API uses "prefetch" and nested error object (error.message, error.code). Python client throws when demoing the sample.
luca: Oof, thanks. Do you have the raw response?
anya: Yep, pasted from staging:
```http
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"message":"missing required field 'source'","code":422}}
```
morgan: That lines up with runtime. Looks like a docs regeneration issue after the param rename. I'll open a PR to fix the OpenAPI examples + the SDK snippet templates.
luca: Please include a tiny migration blurb under Breaking changes: "prefill -> prefetch (parameter rename)" and an example mapping for integrators. Also we need to update any internal quickstarts referencing the old name.
morgan: Created PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4599 — changes:
- update ingest request example to use `prefetch`
- update error response example to nested `error` shape
- update JS and Python sample snippets to read `error.message`
- add Breaking Changes note with mapping
deploy-bot: PR created by morgan: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4599
anya: Couple of small asks: 1) for Python snippet show the pattern `if response.get("error"): raise RuntimeError(response["error"]["message"])` so it's explicit, 2) ensure the OpenAPI example uses the exact runtime JSON (no trailing commas).
morgan: Good catches. Added the Python snippet and fixed example JSON formatting. Also ran docs linter locally.
luca: Can you add a one-liner in the JS sample too? `if (resp.error) { console.error(resp.error.message) }` — saves confusion.
morgan: Added JS snippet. CI: docs-lint passed. Preview build at https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/ingest shows the updated examples.
deploy-bot: CI: docs-lint passed for PR #4599 — https://ci.redwood.ai/12877
anya: I'll regenerate the Python client once this merges and push a patch release to pip (0.8.1 -> 0.8.2) with the parsing fix.
luca: I'll scan the knowledge base for lingering `prefill` mentions (KB + integration guide). If I find any, I'll open a follow-up PR.
morgan: Merged. Preview live.
anya: Smoke-tested against staging with the regenerated client; parsing and error handling work. Closing this thread.
